blocks.html: Class 1 or Class 2 air as described in ASHRAE 62.1 that is conveyed within energy recovery systems shall not be considered as recirculated air where the energy recovery ventilation system is constructed to limit cross-leakage between air streams to less than 10 percent of the total airflow design capacity.
